name: extension-redactor
description: Result gate: on a secret-shaped tool result, ask the human (redact / allow once / allow for session) before it reaches the model

enabled.description: Whether this extension is enabled. Set to false to disable the extension entirely.

prompt.description: Ask the human on a match. Set false to redact without asking (headless posture). A missing or non-interactive UI also redacts without asking - fail closed.

patterns.description: label -> regex source (JavaScript RegExp, case-sensitive). The label is what the human sees and what the allow-for-session grant is keyed by. A user block replaces this map wholesale, so re-include any defaults you want kept. A malformed regex fails the redactor closed: every result is withheld until the config is fixed.
